note: Suggested two-piece pairings, not a tier list. Every item id exists in equipment.json so the art and names are the site's own data. These are opinions about what a pair is good for, not measured game stats.

loadouts.name: Wallbreaker
loadouts.bestFor: Opening a wall ring before a ground smash
loadouts.reason: One item cracks the walls the King would otherwise stall on, the other adds a burst of damage as he walks in behind the main army.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing built from owned equipment; effect strength not measured.

loadouts.name: Damage soak
loadouts.reason: A summoned helper and lifesteal keep him standing longer while the rest of the army works behind him.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; survivability depends on equipment levels.

loadouts.name: Rage rush
loadouts.bestFor: Fast dives onto a single compartment
loadouts.reason: Speed and a spread of extra hits suit a short trip into the base rather than a long tank.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; not tested against current balance.

loadouts.name: Walk sustain
loadouts.bestFor: Queen Walks that have to cross fire
loadouts.reason: Extra bodies and healing keep the walk alive when the Healer cluster is under pressure.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; the guide itself explains when a walk is viable.

loadouts.name: Range sniper
loadouts.bestFor: Picking off defences from outside the wall line
loadouts.reason: Both items extend what she can hit without stepping into the base, which is the safest way to start a walk.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; the ability charge cost is not modelled.

loadouts.name: Core dive
loadouts.bestFor: Queen Charges aimed at the Town Hall or Eagle Artillery
loadouts.reason: Invisibility and a second body let her commit deeper than a walk would allow.

loadouts.name: Fireball walk
loadouts.bestFor: Deleting a compact cluster of defences
loadouts.reason: The damaging ability plus a rage boost turns one cast into a hole the main army can enter through.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; blast radius depends on equipment level.

loadouts.name: Army support
loadouts.bestFor: Keeping a large ground army alive through the core
loadouts.reason: Protection and a stat boost for the troops that follow him rather than damage of his own.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; aura numbers are not modelled here.

loadouts.name: Sustain march
loadouts.bestFor: Long walks where the army trails behind
loadouts.reason: Healing and protection together cover a slow push, at the cost of the Warden's own damage.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; both items share a defensive role.

loadouts.name: Defence hunter
loadouts.bestFor: Sniping defences on the far side
loadouts.reason: Range plus a thrown ability lets her reach buildings the rest of the army cannot.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; ability damage not measured.

loadouts.name: Chase
loadouts.bestFor: Following fast troops into a base
loadouts.reason: Speed and a healing boost suit a hero that arrives after the tanks rather than before them.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; speed values not modelled.

loadouts.name: Hog support
loadouts.bestFor: Hog Rider raids that need a follow-up hero
loadouts.reason: A summoned pack and chained hits add pressure while the hogs work the compartments.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; the guide covers the army, not the equipment.

loadouts.name: Air support
loadouts.bestFor: Air attacks that want extra bodies
loadouts.reason: Summoned helpers and a ranged ability keep pressure on while the main air troops cross the base.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; only three Prince items are on file, so pairs repeat.

loadouts.name: Front line
loadouts.bestFor: Ground pushes where the Prince arrives early
loadouts.reason: Armour and extra bodies make him a better first-in hero than a damage pick would.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; defensive values not modelled.

loadouts.name: Orb pressure
loadouts.bestFor: Chip damage on a defended core
loadouts.reason: A ranged ability plus armour keeps him contributing without committing to a dive.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; not tested against current balance.

loadouts.name: Brawler
loadouts.bestFor: Melee pushes that need a second tank
loadouts.reason: Mobility and a cone of damage suit a hero that fights in the middle of the base.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; damage values not modelled.

loadouts.name: Dive
loadouts.bestFor: Reaching a defence behind the first wall line
loadouts.reason: A jump plus chained hits let him cross a compartment and still hit something useful on arrival.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; cooldown behaviour not verified.

loadouts.name: Burn
loadouts.bestFor: Sustained damage on a stacked compartment
loadouts.reason: Two damage items with no mobility, which is fine when the army has already opened the base.
loadouts.notes: Suggested pairing; no survivability item included.
